entries.summary: Game cards across the catalogue now show researched artwork, including every title that could be verified.
Reopen blocked artwork entries, add service artwork and remove Astra
More game cards now show artwork researched from each game's own published icon, logo or screenshot before any capture was attempted.
Game cards now show real artwork taken from the games themselves, so far more titles are recognisable instead of showing a placeholder.
The original game catalogue is restored, missing series play again, and guest reminders can now be turned off permanently.
Remove the cloud-save overlay, add a Settings changelog, guest reminder and password visibility
Game saving fixed in three clicker games, cloud-save accuracy corrected, and the larger Geegle wordmark with a single Sign out action.
Database fixes for registration, case-insensitive duplicate usernames and save revisions, with tighter permissions.
Username-only accounts can now sign up on the live site, and a deploy check catches a misconfigured backend.
Sticky header search, cleaner root-URL navigation, and fixes for production sign-up and session handling.
Library search with ranked suggestions, the library and proxy notices, and more compact game controls.
A simpler landing page and library: one navigation row, alphabetical sections, neutral styling, and the current Geegle title and footer.
Cloud saves for supported games, a much larger game catalogue, and settings for theme and tab appearance.
Geegle's foundation: accounts and cloud saves backed by Supabase, plus the start of the neutral design system.
